statement.p: Find two numbers differing by 40 whose product is as small as possible.
Enter your two numbers as a comma separated list, e.g. 2, 3.

solution.p: We are trying to find two numbers x and y such that their product P=xy is at a minimum, and we are also given that x-y=40. Solve for one of the variables, say x= 40+y. Substitute back into the product equation to get P= (40+y)y=40 y +y^2 Since we're trying to find a minimum, take the derivative and set it equal to 0. P'= 40+ 2y =0 Thus y=\frac{-40}{2}=-20.
We already said above that x= 40+y, so x=40+( -20)=20.
